heldout_reporting_alpha_allocation.interpretation: In this synthetic condition the exposure channel is slower under .025/.025, so a precommitted .02/.03 split selected only from disjoint meta-campaigns reduces held-out joint reporting delay. This does not alter the decision-IUT and is not a universal allocation recommendation.

A row-digest/replay invariant is required so reporting state cannot silently become a second scientific history.
